## Style from a reference track (ACE-Step 1.5)

**A reference track in, a new track out in its style** - the audio counterpart of img2img. The reference is
encoded into ACE-Step's own latent space (`VAEEncodeAudio`) and re-sampled with **`denoise` below 1** while
`tags` describe the style you want instead. This is the same mechanism, and the same trade-off, as
`pixel-art-restyle` at denoise 0.6 keeping the 3D render's design.

- **`denoise` is the retention dial, and measured (E5) it is biased hard toward the reference.** Against a text-only take of the same tags, similarity to the reference was **0.994 / 0.990 / 0.935 / 0.954** at denoise 0.3 / 0.5 / 0.7 / 0.9 against **0.869 / 0.795 / 0.907 / 0.894** to the text-only take - the reference wins every time, and the curve is **non-monotone** (0.7 is the least reference-like). So treat this as **"make me more of this"** (a soundtrack that stays consistent) rather than as a restyler: "make this industrial" is not what it does. Note also that with the turbo's **8 steps, `denoise` is quantised to eighths** - 0.9 is 7 of 8, so the ladder never reaches a true re-generation.
- **the target length is one knob**: `FloatConstant` feeds both the trim and the encoder's `duration`, because
  the conditioning and the latent have to describe the same length.
- **the reference must be a real audio file** in ComfyUI's `input/` (flac/wav/mp3). Set `tags` to the style you
  want it *changed into*, not the style it already is.

**What this flow does *not* do, and why it matters.** Three different things get called "style transfer" in
audio, and only two are reachable here:

| flavour | reachable | how |
|---|---|---|
| same **timbre / instrumentation**, new arrangement | **yes** | this flow: `VAEEncodeAudio` + partial denoise |
| same **structure**, new style | **yes** | the same flow at *lower* denoise (more of the reference survives) |
| **continue or repair a section** ("Repaint") | **no** | it needs an audio **mask**, and the only candidate, `CreateAudioMask`, is deprecated *and* outputs an IMAGE - a waveform picture - so `SetLatentNoiseMask` cannot take it |

ACE-Step's model card also lists a **"Refer audio"** mode (and Cover/Repaint) as ✅ for this turbo checkpoint.
Those are upstream features the **core ACE-Step nodes do not expose** - they are text-only.

*How to run it: story **S20** in `HOWTO.md`  ·  Why it is this way: E5 in `audio/EXPERIMENTS.md`.*
